basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and RPG enthusiast with a strong passion for role-playing games like Baldur's Gate 3. Based in the Pacific Northwest, I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my evenings diving into fantasy worlds. I enjoy discussing game mechanics and sharing tips with fellow adventurers. Not a fan of toxic communities, I prefer engaging in constructive and respectful discussions. In a long-term relationship, and we often co-op games together. Online mostly in the late evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design and a lifelong passion for gaming, this user has developed a deep understanding of game mechanics and narrative structures. Self-taught in game modding and familiar with software like DOSBox, which they use to relive classic gaming experiences. Engages in continuous learning through community discussions and online resources.
